_comment: Template for ~/.config/pi/agent/settings.json, which is NOT tracked: pi
rewrites it on every install and model switch, and it carries whichever
provider and model this machine happens to use. common/setup.sh reads
`packages` and runs `pi install` for any entry missing from settings.json
(idempotent). `theme` is the default off Omarchy; on Omarchy setup.sh
sets `omarchy-system` instead, which the theme-set hook keeps in sync
with the active Omarchy theme and pi hot-reloads.
Providers and credentials belong in models.json, which is also untracked.
feynman is installed but loads nothing here; vaults enable it via .pi/settings.json (vault-template).
models.json: the work Anthropic proxy rejects forceAdaptiveThinking (output_config) and mid-conversation
tool changes (tool_addition), so never set those compat flags there; the tool set must stay fixed per
session or every change rewrites the whole prompt cache. loadout.ts keeps it fixed.
defaultTools entries are merged into settings.json by setup.sh, keeping local additions.
Skill exclusions are owned by pi-skill-catalog (driven by skill-catalog.json); do not add them here.
